ctx.x: And, this is where I got a chance to really hear some good music. Did you ever hear of Coleridge S. Taylor? This was a colored composer. He composed "Hiawatha's Wedding Feast" -- one of the prettiest things you want to hear. I (unintelligible) first time I'd ever heard anything like that and I really enjoyed that. Of course, that was on the first trumpet. I was playing that, but I would have paid them to let me sit in on that. That was really good. And we had violins in there.

A fellow by the name of David Taylor, he was the first violinist and I was first chair trumpeter on that ting. But it was so pretty, because it started -- da-da-da-da- -- and on and on and on. This fellow had a -- he had a tenor solo that he had to sing and oh, if that fellow didn't get some hands on that solo. was singing "swake, swake" He could sing it (unintelligible) from Coleridge Taylor's "Hiawatha's Wedding Feast." [PAUSE - APPROVED]
-- songs that you played at Biddle?
